v = int(input())
cand = [0] * 17
cand[0] = 1
for i in range(1, 17):
    cand[i] = cand[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def recursive(index, value):
    value = abs(value)
    if index == 0:
        return int(value)
    quotient1 = int(value // cand[index])
    quotient2 = quotient1 + 1
    option1 = quotient1 * (index + 1) + recursive(index - 1, value - quotient1 * cand[index])
    option2 = quotient2 * (index + 1) + recursive(index - 1, value - quotient2 * cand[index])
    return min(option1, option2)

print(recursive(16, v))
